title: Sharp $p$-Capacity Estimates via Quermassintegrals in Hyperbolic Space
summary: This paper establishes sharp upper bounds for $p$-capacities $\mathrm{Cap}_{1 2m+1$, an interpolating radius combines the $2m$-th curvature-excess radius with the $L^\infty$ curvature scale, thereby linking the finite-moment and supremum regimes. Equality in the sharp comparisons characterizes geodesic balls.
